_This page is generated from the doc comments of what src/index.ts exports, so it says what the tool does._

```js
import { evaluate, loadCases, HARNESSES } from "skill-evals";
```

[Use it from code](../guides/from-code.md) shows an evaluation from start to end. The package ships type declarations, so everything on this page is typed in TypeScript.

## Functions and values

### loadCases()

```ts
function loadCases(
  casesDir: string,
  glob?: string,
  options?: LoadOptions,
): Case[];
```

Loads the cases of a suite.

| Parameter           | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `casesDir`          | A directory that holds the cases at any depth. A case is a directory with a `prompt.md` or a `case.json`, and its id is its path below `casesDir`, with `/`. |
| `glob`              | Selects cases by id: `*` stays within one directory, `**` crosses directories, `?` is one character and `{a,b}` is either. Default: every case.              |
| `options`           | `lenient` drops a key that a case file does not take instead of failing, and `onWarning` hears of each one.                                                  |
| `options.lenient`   | Drop unknown keys instead of failing. Default: false.                                                                                                        |
| `options.onWarning` | Called with a line of text for each key that `lenient` drops.                                                                                                |

**Returns.** Every matching case, sorted by id.

**Throws `UsageError`.** When the directory cannot be read, a case is invalid, or no case matches.

### evaluate()

```ts
function evaluate(given: EvaluateOptions): Promise<Evaluation>;
```

Runs every case against each subject, scores the runs, and writes `results.json` and each run's files to the output directory. One subject is scored on its own. With two, the first is the baseline and the second is the one under test, which the pass bars apply to. It prints nothing and never calls process.exit. While it runs, SIGINT and SIGTERM end the process with exit code 130 after the cleanup.

| Parameter | Description                                                                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `given`   | What to evaluate and how. An option that is not set takes its value from the project's config file. |

**Returns.** The scores, every run record, and where the files are.

**Throws `UsageError`.** For a wrong option, case file, or config file, before any harness starts.

### HARNESSES

The harness adapters in default-preference order: the first installed one runs when `--harness` is absent. Pi leads because it has the smallest install, the fastest start, and reports tokens and cost.

```ts
const HARNESSES: Harness[];
```

## Types

### Capability

The name of something a harness can observe or do.

```ts
type Capability = keyof typeof CAPABILITIES;
```

### Need

What a case or a check can need: a capability of the harness, or `bin:<name>`, an executable on the host's `PATH`.

```ts
type Need = Capability | `bin:${string}`;
```

### Case

One prompt and what a good run of it does.

| Property         | Type                      | Description                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`             | `string`                  |                                                                                                                 |
| `prompt`         | `string`                  |                                                                                                                 |
| `checks`         | `Check[]`                 |                                                                                                                 |
| `weight`         | `number`                  |                                                                                                                 |
| `minScore?`      | `number \| undefined`     |                                                                                                                 |
| `maxTurns?`      | `number \| undefined`     |                                                                                                                 |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `number`                  |                                                                                                                 |
| `requires`       | `Need[]`                  | What a harness must be able to do for the case to apply, besides what its checks imply.                         |
| `harnesses?`     | `string[] \| undefined`   | The harnesses the case is for, when it is for some only. A last resort: `note` says why.                        |
| `note?`          | `string \| undefined`     | Why the case is limited to `harnesses`; the report shows it as the reason the case is not applicable elsewhere. |
| `tags`           | `string[]`                | Labels that `--tag`, `--tag-all` and `--not-tag` select by.                                                     |
| `description?`   | `string \| undefined`     | What the case shows, in a sentence.                                                                             |
| `targets`        | `string[]`                | The names of the skills the case is about; the coverage table counts them.                                      |
| `kind?`          | `string \| undefined`     | The kind of case, such as `trigger`.                                                                            |
| `expected?`      | `string \| undefined`     | What a good run does, in a sentence for readers.                                                                |
| `guard`          | `boolean`                 | True for a case that must keep passing. The report lists it apart, and it is scored like any case.              |
| `reps?`          | `number \| undefined`     | Runs for each subject, in place of `--reps`.                                                                    |
| `model?`         | `string \| undefined`     | The model of the agent in this case's runs, in place of `--model`.                                              |
| `judgeModel?`    | `string \| undefined`     | The model that scores this case's judged checks, in place of `--judge-model`.                                   |
| `env`            | `Record<string, string>`  | Variables the agent's process gets, set outright.                                                               |
| `minDelta?`      | `number \| undefined`     | The least score difference between the subjects that the case must show.                                        |
| `workspaceDir`   | `string \| null`          | A directory whose content the agent starts with, or null for an empty workspace.                                |
| `extensions`     | `Record<string, unknown>` | The keys of the case file that start with `x-`, which belong to the case's author.                              |

### Check

One thing a case expects of a run.

```ts
type Check = RuledCheck | JudgedCheck | DecisionCheck;
```

### Evaluation

What `evaluate` returns. The evaluation succeeded when `belowBar`, `invalid` and `sourceChanged` are all empty.

| Property        | Type                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cases`         | `Case[]`                                                                      | Every loaded case, applicable or not.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `applied`       | `Record<string, Case[]>`                                                      | For each harness id, the cases it ran, with the checks that it dropped left out.                                                                                                                        |
| `outDir`        | `string`                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `subjects`      | `SubjectSummary[]`                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `harnesses`     | `string[]`                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `harnessReason` | `string`                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `model`         | `string \| null`                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `judge`         | `string`                                                                      | The harness and model that scored the judged checks, in words.                                                                                                                                          |
| `decisionModel` | `string \| null`                                                              | The model that scored the decision checks; null when none is set.                                                                                                                                       |
| `reps`          | `number`                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `caseMeta`      | `Record<string, CaseMeta>`                                                    | For each case id, what its file holds besides its checks: its labels, what it is about, its overrides, its `x-` keys.                                                                                   |
| `suites`        | `SuiteScore[]`                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `belowBar`      | `string[]`                                                                    | The pass bars that were not reached.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `notApplicable` | `{ harness: string; caseId: string; missing: string[]; reason: string; }[]`   | The pairs of harness and case that were not run, because the harness lacks what the case needs. No score, no runs.                                                                                      |
| `skippedChecks` | `{ harness: string; caseId: string; checks: string[]; missing: string[]; }[]` | The checks that a harness dropped from a case that still ran, because they say `ifUnsupported: "skip"`.                                                                                                 |
| `commonSet`     | `CommonSet \| null`                                                           | The score over the cases that apply to every harness that has any, for each harness and subject label. Only that number compares harnesses. Null when fewer than two harnesses have an applicable case. |
| `invalid`       | `string[]`                                                                    | The runs that do not count, each with its reason.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sourceChanged` | `string[]`                                                                    | The paths of a subject directory that changed while the command ran, each as the user would type it.                                                                                                    |
| `records`       | `RunRecord[]`                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### EvaluateOptions

What `evaluate` takes. An option that is not set takes its value from the project's config file.

| Property           | Type                                         | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cwd?`             | `string \| undefined`                        | The working directory, which sets the project and what relative paths resolve against. Default: the process's. |
| `subjects`         | `string[]`                                   | One or two of a directory, a git ref of the project, or "none".                                                |
| `harness?`         | `string \| undefined`                        | Comma-separated harness ids, or "all". Default: the first installed harness.                                   |
| `cases?`           | `string \| undefined`                        | The directory that holds the cases. Default: `evals/cases` in the project.                                     |
| `env?`             | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Names of variables the harness gets besides the allowlist. Default: `env` of the config file.                  |
| `subjectExclude?`  | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Globs, relative to the subject, of what a run never gets. Default: `subjectExclude` of the config file.        |
| `reps?`            | `number \| undefined`                        | Runs for each subject and case. A case's own `reps` wins. Default: 3.                                          |
| `model?`           | `string \| undefined`                        | Passed to the harness. A case's own `model` wins. Default: the harness's own default.                          |
| `judgeHarness?`    | `string \| undefined`                        | The harness that scores judged checks. Default: the harness under test.                                        |
| `judgeModel?`      | `string \| undefined`                        | The model that scores judged checks. A case's own `judgeModel` wins. Default: `model`.                         |
| `decisionModel?`   | `string \| undefined`                        | The model that scores decision checks. No default: a suite with a decision check needs it.                     |
| `decisionUrl?`     | `string \| undefined`                        | The base URL of the decision model's API. Default: the provider's own.                                         |
| `decisionTimeout?` | `number \| undefined`                        | The seconds one request to the decision model may take, a positive integer. Default: 60.                       |
| `lenient?`         | `boolean \| undefined`                       | Drop a key that a case file does not take, and warn, instead of failing. Default: false.                       |
| `isolated?`        | `boolean \| undefined`                       | Start the harness with nothing loaded but the subject, and invalidate a run that reports more. Default: false. |
| `onWarning?`       | `((text: string) => void) \| undefined`      | Called with a line of text for each key that `lenient` drops.                                                  |
| `minScore?`        | `number \| undefined`                        | The pass bar for the suite score of the subject under test.                                                    |
| `outDir?`          | `string \| undefined`                        | Where results go. Default: a new temp directory.                                                               |
| `onRun?`           | `((record: RunRecord) => void) \| undefined` | Called with each run's record as soon as the run ends.                                                         |
| `caseGlob?`        | `string \| string[] \| undefined`            | Globs over case ids to run; one glob, or a list of them. Default: every case.                                  |
| `notCase?`         | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Globs over case ids to leave out.                                                                              |
| `tag?`             | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Run a case that has any of these tags.                                                                         |
| `tagAll?`          | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Run a case that has all of these tags.                                                                         |
| `notTag?`          | `string[] \| undefined`                      | Leave out a case that has any of these tags.                                                                   |

### Harness

The adapter of one coding-agent CLI.

| Property        | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `bin`           | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | The name of the executable on PATH.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `authFiles`     | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Login files to copy into the throwaway home, relative to the user's home.                                                                                                                               |
| `authEnv`       | `string[]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Variables of the user's environment that carry the harness's login or choose its provider; they reach it by name.                                                                                       |
| `capabilities`  | `ReadonlySet<"subagents" \| "multiTurn" \| "userInvoke" \| "toolOutputs" \| "assistantText" \| "turnGrouping" \| "childCalls" \| "childText" \| "rules" \| "hooks" \| "history" \| "historyNative" \| "askUser" \| "toolDurations" \| "sessionStore" \| "compact" \| "clear" \| "resume" \| "mcp" \| "skillListing" \| "loadedReport" \| "isolated" \| "sandbox">` | What the adapter can observe or do, each proven by a parser test on a stream. A case that needs more is not applicable.                                                                                 |
| `status`        | `"real-model" \| "scripted" \| "unverified"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | How far the adapter is proven: a real model ran, a scripted endpoint ran, or neither (see agents/verified).                                                                                             |
| `invocation`    | `(input: RunInput) => Invocation`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `parse`         | `(stdout: string) => Parsed`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | May throw on a stream it does not understand; the caller reports that as a failed run.                                                                                                                  |
| `foreign?`      | `((loaded: Loaded, subject: LoadedSubject \| null) => string[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Names what the harness reported that does not come from the subject, for a harness whose report needs more than the shared rule. Absent: `foreignDefault`.                                              |
| `isolation?`    | `Isolation \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | How the adapter isolates a run, for an adapter with the `isolated` capability. `invocation` uses these same `args` and `env` when the run is isolated.                                                  |
| `isolationGap?` | `string \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Why a harness without `isolation` cannot run `--isolated`, for the docs.                                                                                                                                |
| `strays?`       | `((run: { home: string; placed: Record<string, string> \| undefined; }) => string[]) \| undefined`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Names what a finished run left in the run's home that the run did not place, such as skills the account synced there. The report of what loaded does not show them. Called while the home still exists. |

### Isolation

The switches that make a harness load nothing but the subject, and what the run record proves of that.

| Property    | Type                     | Description                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `args`      | `string[]`               | Command-line arguments added when the run is isolated.                                   |
| `env`       | `Record<string, string>` | Environment variables added when the run is isolated.                                    |
| `proves`    | `string`                 | What the report of what loaded covers.                                                   |
| `notProven` | `string`                 | What no switch removes and the report does not show.                                     |
| `notes`     | `string`                 | Markdown bullet list of what the switches do and what was read in the CLI, for the docs. |

### Loaded

What a harness says it loaded at startup. Null means the harness does not report that kind of thing.

| Property     | Type                                                     | Description                                                                                      |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `paths`      | `string[] \| null`                                       | The directories of its plugins.                                                                  |
| `skills`     | `string[] \| null`                                       | The names of its skills, without any plugin prefix.                                              |
| `agents`     | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                  |
| `rules`      | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                  |
| `hooks`      | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                  |
| `mcpServers` | `string[] \| null`                                       |                                                                                                  |
| `rawSkills?` | `string[] \| null \| undefined`                          | The skill names as the harness listed them, with any plugin prefix, for an adapter that has one. |
| `plugins?`   | `{ name: string; path: string; }[] \| null \| undefined` | The plugins with their names, for an adapter that reports them.                                  |

### LoadedSubject

A plugin or a skills folder: a subject that puts something into the harness.

```ts
type LoadedSubject = Pick<Subject, "skills" | "skillDirs"> & {
  kind: "plugin" | "skills";
  dir: string;
};
```

### Parsed

A harness's output stream in the one shape every harness shares. Null means the harness does not report the field.

| Property    | Type             | Description                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `finalText` | `string`         |                                                                                                                   |
| `toolCalls` | `ToolCall[]`     |                                                                                                                   |
| `tokens`    | `Tokens \| null` |                                                                                                                   |
| `costUsd`   | `number \| null` |                                                                                                                   |
| `loaded`    | `Loaded`         | What the harness says it loaded at startup: its plugin directories, skills, agents, rules, hooks and MCP servers. |
| `error`     | `string \| null` |                                                                                                                   |

### Tokens

Token counts; input counts every prompt token, cached ones included.

| `output` | `number` |             |

### CheckResult

A check with what it gave one run.

```ts
type CheckResult = Check & {
  /** Null when a judged check or a decision check got no usable answer. */
  score: number | null;
  /** The judge's reason, or why there is no score. */
  reason?: string;
  /** For a decision check, the probability the model gave each allowed answer. */
  probabilities?: Record<string, number>;
};
```

### RunRecord

Everything kept about one run.

| `subject`        | `string`                               | The subject's label.                                                                                                            |

| `isolated`       | `boolean`                              | Whether the run was started with `--isolated`.                                                                                  |

| `judgeProblem`   | `string \| null`                       | Why the judge session, which loads nothing, does not prove it loaded nothing; null when it does, or when no isolated judge ran. |

| `decision`       | `(Usage & { calls: number; }) \| null` | What the decision checks cost, kept apart in the same way; null when no request was sent.                                       |
| `durationMs`     | `number`                               |                                                                                                                                 |
| `tokens`         | `Tokens \| null`                       |                                                                                                                                 |

### SubjectSummary

The part of a subject that goes into `results.json` and the report.
